venues.description: Large quinta on the road into La Huasteca canyon with a roofed salon-terrace, gardens, a small waterfall and pond and a lookout, rented with a kitchen for your own caterer.
venues.setting_why: The Huasteca cliffs make a dramatic backdrop, but the quinta itself (pool, play area) is basic and reviews mention upkeep problems.
venues.taq_txt: No in-house catering and no banquet exclusivity; the kitchen is provided for the couple's caterer.
venues.winter_note: Roofed salon-terrace for 500+, but open-sided, so cold nights need panels or heaters.
venues.catch: Weak reviews: dirty grounds and power cuts reported
